name: HAMARTIA
source:
Two sisters fall through an endless void, chasing the meaning of freedom. One seeks stillness, the other movement. Both descend toward something neither can name.

[From [url=https://laudy.itch.io/hamartia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两姐妹坠入无尽的虚空，追逐自由的意义。一个追求静止，另一个追求运动。两人都坠向了一些谁都无法说出的事物。

[来自[url=https://laudy.itch.io/hamartia]Itch.io[/url]]
